svg.title: Foil Supper: Two-colour risograph recipe card
svg.desc: Foil Supper (1D): a two-colour risograph recipe card of the camp table from above. On the left the cooler shelf of ingredient tiles with their counts; in the middle foil packets, each with four spaces for Base, Body, Fat and Flavour, one of them still empty while an olive-oil tile is dragged in with its pencil score. On the right the recipe card with its heading gone blank, and along the bottom the coal bar burning down.
